name: SwiftWatchesMovies
author: pvmook@planet.nl
description: SwiftWatchesMovies: a Node.js site that browses TheMovieDB (movies & TV) and AniList (anime), plays them through embeddable players, and - with Swift Servers - streams torrents through its own player. Serves the UI on the allocated port.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
# Movie & TV Stream Search Site - installation script (POSIX sh)
echo "Starting installation..."

# The yolks node image already ships with git; install it only if missing.
if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "git not found - attempting to install it..."
    if command -v apt >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt update -y && apt install -y git; fi
    if command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then apk add --no-cache git; fi
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo "Using git repository: ${GIT_ADDRESS}"

    # Ensure the URL ends with .git (POSIX case statement)
    case "${GIT_ADDRESS}" in
        *.git) ;;
        *) GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git" ;;
    esac

    # Inject credentials for private repositories
    if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
        echo "Using supplied git credentials"
        GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo "${GIT_ADDRESS}" | cut -d/ -f3-)"
    fi

    BRANCH="${BRANCH:-main}"

    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo "Existing repository found - pulling latest changes..."
        git pull || echo "git pull failed, continuing with existing files"
    elif [ -n "$(ls -A /mnt/server 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        echo "Directory not empty - cloning into a temp dir and copying in..."
        rm -rf /tmp/app
        git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /tmp/app
        cp -a /tmp/app/. /mnt/server/
        rm -rf /tmp/app
    else
        echo "Cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS} (branch ${BRANCH})..."
        git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
    fi
else
    echo "====================================================="
    echo "No GIT_ADDRESS provided - skipping git clone."
    echo "Upload your project files (server.js, package.json and"
    echo "the public/ folder) to /home/container via SFTP or the"
    echo "panel File Manager, then (re)start the server."
    echo "====================================================="
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    echo "Pre-installing npm dependencies..."
    cd /mnt/server && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund || echo "npm install will be retried on startup"
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------------------"
echo "Install stage complete."
echo "-----------------------------------------------------"

variables.name: TMDB API Key
variables.description: Your TheMovieDB API key. Get one free at themoviedb.org > Settings > API. Accepts a v3 API key or a v4 read access token. REQUIRED for search to work.

variables.name: 111Movies Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for the 111Movies source only (no trailing slash). Change if that provider's domain moves. The other sources (VidFast, VidSrc, CineSrc, VidEasy) are built in.

variables.name: Default Source
variables.description: Which movie/TV server is selected first: 111movies, vidfast, vidsrc, cinesrc, videasy, or swift (Swift Servers, needs a torrent source below). Viewers can switch per-title in the player.

variables.name: Default Anime Source
variables.description: Which anime server is selected first: vidplus, videasy, megaplay, or swift (Swift Servers). Viewers can switch per-title in the player.

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: HTTPS git URL to install the app from. Defaults to the project repo. Leave blank to upload files manually instead.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone / pull when using a git repository.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Set to 1 to 'git pull' on every startup (only applies when installed from a git repository).

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Optional. Username for cloning a private git repository.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Optional. Personal access token for cloning a private git repository.

variables.name: Swift Servers: Stremio Addons
variables.description: Torrent sources for the Swift Servers (our own player). Stremio stream addon URL(s) - the manifest URL you would install in Stremio (Torrentio-style addons). Separate several with spaces. Leave both this and Torznab empty to hide Swift Servers.

variables.name: Swift Servers: Torznab URLs
variables.description: Optional extra torrent sources: Torznab feed URL(s) from Jackett or Prowlarr, separated by spaces.

variables.name: Swift Servers: Torznab API Key
variables.description: API key for the Torznab URLs (Jackett/Prowlarr), unless it is already inside the URL.

variables.name: Swift Servers: Cache Size (GB)
variables.description: Disk space torrents may use. Idle torrents are deleted first; keep this below the server disk limit.

variables.name: Swift Servers: Max Active Torrents
variables.description: How many torrents can stream at the same time.

variables.name: Swift Servers: Allow Transcoding
variables.description: 1 = re-encode videos the browser cannot play (e.g. HEVC in Firefox) to H.264 720p. CPU heavy; one at a time. 0 = never.

variables.name: Swift Servers: Torrent Port
variables.description: Optional: an extra allocation port for incoming peers (faster). 0 = outgoing connections only.

variables.name: Swift Servers: Upload Limit (KB/s)
variables.description: Limit seeding/upload speed in KB/s. 0 = unlimited.
